title: Structured handoff messages when external tools fail
description: When an external tool fails (login, captcha, permission, quota, timeout, DOM error, offscreen/minimized window, black capture), the UI shows a structured message: WHAT tool, WHAT block, WHAT evidence, WHAT human action, whether local fallback is viable.
resume_hint: P0.8 implements post-remediation recapture: _attempt_post_remediation_recapture() captures ONE image after successful remediation, validates with P0.3 validators, records before/after metrics. Integration wired: if recapture improves, flow continues; if still black, shared reality handoff maintained. Next: live Windows proof.
next_action: P0.9: live Windows proof with P0.8 code. Verify recapture after Win32 restore produces useful image. OSES should detect improved recapture patterns.

metadata.coverage_detail: _human_external_consultation_failure classifies 7 failure types (security_verification, codex_state_missing, access_denied, session_expired, timeout, quota, generic). Each produces structured handoff with tool name, block type, evidence, human action, and local fallback mention.
metadata.p01_additions: Runtime audit trace logs blocked external tools with terminal_state and provider info. Blocked dispatches correctly derive terminal_state from payload.meta (not 'success').
metadata.p02_additions: trace_dispatch_started() emits provider and user_goal_excerpt on external_consultation spawn. Lifecycle can now be reconstructed: started(provider=ChatGPT) → terminal(blocked_by_permission). latestDispatchLifecycle exposes last result to UI.
metadata.p03_additions: _window_rect_is_captureable() detects offscreen/minimized windows (left/top <= -30000, width/height < 50px). _capture_is_low_information() detects blank captures (blank_probability >= 0.90, dynamic_range == 0, unique_color_count <= 2). _validate_visual_evidence_result() prevents treating black capture as success. _visual_handoff_message() builds structured user guidance. Runtime audit traces visual_evidence_snapshot with status=unresolved. Live evidence: user reported ChatGPT window at rect=[-32000,-32000,199,34], blank_probability=0.98, dynamic_range=0, unique_color_count=1.
metadata.p04_additions: _build_shared_reality_handoff() creates causal handoff package explaining user/IABV gap. _detect_user_mismatch_claim() identifies 'a mí sí me funciona' patterns. _build_causal_explanation() generates 'Tu vista vs Vista de IABV' comparison. _shared_reality_user_message() builds full user-facing causal message. _attach_evidence_to_handoff() exposes screenshot path. _trace_shared_reality_handoff() logs shared_reality_handoff event to RuntimeAuditTracer. Integrated into _execute_external_consultation_sync visual override flow.
metadata.p05_additions: OSES _shared_reality_handoff_findings() reads shared_reality_handoff events from runtime_audit.jsonl. Detects 4 patterns: repeated_visual_mismatch (≥2 useless captures), user_browser_differs_from_iabv_session (≥2 isolated session events), black_capture_repeated (≥2 blank_probability≥0.8), user_needed_to_explain_same_gap (≥2 user claims). PortableContext _shared_reality_section() exports compact summary without PII. Single events do NOT generate findings — only repetition.

p04_live_case.user_claim: a mí sí me funciona y a él no
p04_live_case.root_cause: User sees their normal Chrome browser with ChatGPT working. IABV uses Chrome for Testing (isolated session) which is minimized/offscreen. The causal handoff now explains this difference.

metadata.p06_additions: _assess_visual_remediation() classifies failed capture into: no_action_needed, remediation_available, needs_user_selection, unresolved. _attempt_safe_remediation() attempts reversible Win32 ShowWindow restore if hwnd is valid. _trace_visual_remediation_attempted() logs visual_remediation_attempted event with before/after metrics. _remediation_user_message() builds practical user-facing guidance. Wired into _execute_external_consultation_sync: runs assessment+remediation before shared reality handoff. Controlled session mismatch detection appends browser selector recommendation.
metadata.p07_additions: OSES _visual_remediation_findings() reads visual_remediation_attempted events from runtime_audit.jsonl (tail-first, 50 most recent). Detects 4 patterns (min 2 events): repeated_restore_without_recapture (action taken but capture_useful_after=None), repeated_win32_restore_unavailable (Win32 API not available), repeated_user_selection_needed (proposed_action=request_user_selection), repeated_restore_attempted (restore was attempted, measure improvement). PortableContext _shared_reality_section() extended to include P0.7 remediation categories.
metadata.p08_additions: _attempt_post_remediation_recapture() attempts ONE recapture after successful remediation. Gated on: remediation_success=True, hwnd valid positive int, proposed_action in (restore_window_by_hwnd, restore_and_recapture). Uses PIL ImageGrab.grab(bbox=rect) for targeted recapture. Validates with _capture_is_low_information(). Records before/after: capture_useful_after, blank_probability_after, recapture_status (improved|still_low_information|skipped|error). If recapture improves, flow continues with success=True. If still low-information, shared reality handoff maintained. Trace event includes recapture_status field. Integration wired into _execute_external_consultation_sync visual override path.
